# GrailPay

GrailPay is a Financial Services company. GrailPay is a risk intelligence platform for modern payments that scores risk on every payment before money moves and guarantees what qualifies, across ACH and instant rails. GrailPay employs 24 people (+64.3% YoY, +9 people). Headquartered in New York, New York, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and India.

## About

GrailPay's Risk Intelligence Platform protects faster, irreversible payments with preemptive screening of user identity and intent, establishing an auditable, compliant system for fighting payment risk at scale.

  > For most of banking history, a payment came with a pause. Money left one account and took time to land in another. That gap felt like a flaw, but it was also a safety net. It provided time to catch fraud, reverse a mistake, and let a human look twice before a loss became permanent.
  >
  > Instant rails, stablecoins, and agentic commerce remove that pause and take away the window that used to compensate for not really knowing your counterparty. A payment is final the second it moves.
  >
  > Card payments always had a de facto guarantee built into the rail. Bank payments never did. Now they're getting faster, more automated, and increasingly run between counterparties (and soon, agents) with little shared history.
  >
  > Lower trust, less time, higher stakes, all at once.
  >
  > Knowing an account is real is a good check. It doesn't tell you whether this payment, in this context, should happen; the amount, the timing, the counterparty's history, the velocity. That's where the real signal lives.
  >
  > So the discipline the pause used to give us for free now has to be designed in.
  >
  > That's what we build:
  >
  > 🧠 Account Intelligence
  > Validation before the payment. Signal-rich bank account validation that tells you how much to trust an account before it ever transacts.
  >
  > 🛡️ Transaction Intelligence
  > Judgment at the speed of the payment. Every transaction scored in real time, in context, so the risky one stops and the good one moves with confidence.
  >
  > Risk and payments aren't two businesses for us. Better data prices risk, priced risk makes faster payments safe to originate, and every payment sharpens the data. That flywheel is the whole thesis.
  >
  > The pause is gone. We're building the data layer that replaces it, and hiring the engineers and data minds who read risk early and act before the window closes. If that's how you think about payments, let's talk.
  >
  > Interested in learning more about our Risk Intelligence platform? Read our latest blog posts, linked in the comments.
